title: ALMA Observations of Layered Structures due to CO Selective Dissociation in the ρ Ophiuchi A Plane-parallel PDR
question: Does the rho Oph A PDR show layered CO isotopologue structures from selective dissociation, indicating a plane-parallel rather than clumpy PDR, and how do 13CO/C18O abundance ratios vary?

what.value: G0=(3–4)e3 FUV intensity at PDR shell

evidence.quote: The FUV intensity at the PDR shell was estimated to be $G_0$=(3–4)$\times$10$^3$ ((cite: Shimajiri17)).

what.value: lower limit Tex 45 K from JCMT 12CO(3-2)

evidence.quote: we set the lower limit of the excitation temperature as 45 K, as previously estimated from the JCMT $^{12}$CO ($J$=3–2) data ((cite: White15))
significantly larger than the 5.5 seen in the solar system ((cite: Anders89))
measured toward another flat-spectrum YSO, HL Tau, is $\sim$4 ((cite: Wu18))

recipe.goal: Identify CO layered structure in channel maps
recipe.method: Inspect channel maps of 12CO, 13CO, C18O at 2.2–2.6 km/s relative to S1 and the 1.3 mm continuum

recipe.goal: Derive Tex, optical depths and column densities, then R13/18 maps
recipe.method: Tex from peak 12CO brightness temperature; tau13, tau18 from that Tex; N under LTE via Nishimura15 eq. 11
assumptions: common Tex among isotopologues; 12CO(2-1) heavily optically thick; LTE

recipe.goal: Radial profile of R13/18 and comparison with PDR models
recipe.method: Profile versus projected distance from S1, error propagation formula, compare with van Dishoeck & Black 1988 scaled by density

recipe.goal: GY-51 CO intensity ratio and disk dust mass
recipe.method: Spectra from 3.6"x2.4" region of 12-m data; ratio lower limit; dust mass from 1.3 mm flux
assumptions: Tdust=60 K, kappa1.3mm=2.3 cm2/g, gas-to-dust 100, CO/H2 6e-5, Tgas=60 K, disk radius 70 au, 12C/13C=62

evidence.quote: $R_{13/18}$ is as high as 40 near the shell
rapidly decreases from 20–40 to the standard value in a small angular scale of 3$\ensuremath{''}$–5$\ensuremath{''}$
is 3.8 Jy beam$^{-1}$ which corresponds to a brightness temperature of 69 K
the $^{12}$CO emission is clearly detected (3.2$\pm$0.1 Jy km s$^{-1}$)
The 3$\sigma$ lower limit of the $I(^{12}{\rm CO}(2-1))/I(^{13}{\rm CO}(2-1))$ intensity ratio is $>21$.
total flux density of 40.5 mJy within a $3.6\ensuremath{''}\times2.4\ensuremath{''}$ region

not_stated_but_needed: CASA version, calibration and imaging parameters (weighting, deconvolver, masks, continuum subtraction), since deferred to Kawabe18
Exact procedure and pixel selection for Tex/column density maps
score_reason: Public data and simple analysis, but imaging details deferred to Kawabe18 and no software named.
rediscovery_reason: Public data, numeric results from simple LTE analysis, though imaging settings are inherited.
